facts.text: Melanie mentions waking up to the sound of birds and the smell of fresh air during camping trips, which she says refreshes her soul.

evidence.quote: It's so peaceful waking up to the sound of birds and the smell of fresh air - it always refreshes my soul.

facts.text: Melanie states that camping trips with her family allow her to reset and recharge, as nature brings peace and serenity.

evidence.quote: It really helps me reset and recharge. I love camping trips with my fam, 'cause nature brings such peace and serenity.

facts.text: Caroline comments that Melanie can picture waking up to nature and finds it peaceful and calming.

evidence.quote: That's so peaceful and calming, Melanie! I can picture waking up to nature.

facts.text: Caroline agrees with Melanie that camping trips with family provide quality, tranquil time and are priceless.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Caroline! This is a great time. Nature and quality time, can't beat it!
Yeah totally! They're priceless. Lucky you!
